## Crystal Dragon, Wyrmling (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 CG Tiny dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +6

 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 17, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)  
 **hp** 22 (3d12+3)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  
 **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 100 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** bite +5 (1d4-1), 2 claws +4 (1d3-1)  
 **Space** 2.5 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft. (5 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (15-ft. cone, 2d4 sonic, DC 12)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 9, **Dex** 16, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 13 (17 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Bluff +11, Climb +13, Disguise +8, Fly +13, Perception +6, Stealth +17; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Draconic  
 **SQ** razor sharp  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  
 
    
  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
